meta_description_en: Editorial for Outlet issue 31: increasing contributor payments, SwiftDisc format interest, errata, and ZX Spectrum +3 listing troubleshooting.
meta_description_ru: Редакционная колонка журнала Outlet #031: повышение гонораров авторам, обсуждение формата SwiftDisc, исправления ошибок и технические заметки о ZX Spectrum +3.
body_en_plain:
We're happy to report there is a
bit more cash in the kitty this
year compared to last and so we
are increasing the payment made
to readers contributing programs
and articles etc.by about 25%.
Typical `5 to `10 items now make
`7 to `13. Nice littler earners!

A reader's offered to duplicate
the microdrive version of OUTLET
onto SWIFTDISC. It is not likely
to be practical for us to take
up this offer but just how many
readers would be interested? If
there's sufficient demand it may
be possible with certain limits.

In PROT in last month we omitted
the most important info in the
instructions! Use RANDOMIZE USR
55000 to actually PRINT the
contents of A$. You guessed that
anyway didn't you?

The index data was missing from
the +3 version of Issue 28 but
the data was included in Issue
29's data so load that in OUTDEX
and you'll be up to date.

We have had inquiries as to why
our listings are corrupted on a
+3. It is due to the design of
the 128K BASIC which turns to a
different page of memory when
you BREAK into a program and can
no longer find any new character
set (text shapes) loaded. If you
reset the computer and MERGE the
program you can see the listing.

You may have seen advertisements
for m/drive cartridges at `4.50
to `4.75 but be assured we shall
hold our price for OUTLET on
microdrive until all stocks run
out even though we are only
Charging about HALF  the above
per cartridge INCLUDING OUTLET!
(Sorry no- you can't buy 500 and
sell 'em at a profit!)

Finally, thanks to all the many
readers who wrote in with the
address of a supplier of a print
head for the Brother M1009. One
will be ordered in due course
and streaky graphics will be no
more...




       Ron & Brian Cavers
       CHEZRON   SOFTWARE
     605, Loughborough Road
   Birstall,Leicester LE4 4NJ.

body_en:
## Editorial

We're happy to report there is a bit more cash in the kitty this year compared to last and so we are increasing the payment made to readers contributing programs and articles etc. by about 25%. Typical `5 to `10 items now make `7 to `13. Nice littler earners!

A reader's offered to duplicate the microdrive version of OUTLET onto SWIFTDISC. It is not likely to be practical for us to take up this offer but just how many readers would be interested? If there's sufficient demand it may be possible with certain limits.

In PROT in last month we omitted the most important info in the instructions! Use RANDOMIZE USR 55000 to actually PRINT the contents of A$. You guessed that anyway didn't you?

The index data was missing from the +3 version of Issue 28 but the data was included in Issue 29's data so load that in OUTDEX and you'll be up to date.

We have had inquiries as to why our listings are corrupted on a +3. It is due to the design of the 128K BASIC which turns to a different page of memory when you BREAK into a program and can no longer find any new character set (text shapes) loaded. If you reset the computer and MERGE the program you can see the listing.

You may have seen advertisements for m/drive cartridges at `4.50 to `4.75 but be assured we shall hold our price for OUTLET on microdrive until all stocks run out even though we are only Charging about HALF the above per cartridge INCLUDING OUTLET! (Sorry no- you can't buy 500 and sell 'em at a profit!)

Finally, thanks to all the many readers who wrote in with the address of a supplier of a print head for the Brother M1009. One will be ordered in due course and streaky graphics will be no more...

Ron & Brian Cavers  
CHEZRON SOFTWARE  
605, Loughborough Road  
Birstall, Leicester LE4 4NJ.
body_ru:
## От редакции

Мы рады сообщить, что в кассе в этом году прибавилось деньжат по сравнению с прошлым, поэтому мы увеличиваем гонорары читателям, присылающим программы, статьи и т.д., примерно на 25%. Обычные материалы за `5–`10 теперь принесут `7–`13. Неплохой приработок!

Один читатель предложил дублировать microdrive-версию OUTLET на дискеты SWIFTDISC. Вряд ли это будет нам практически удобно, но многим ли читателям это было бы интересно? Если наберётся достаточный спрос, то в определенных рамках это возможно.

В описании к PROT в прошлом месяце мы упустили самое главное! Чтобы напечатать содержимое A$, используйте RANDOMIZE USR 55000. Впрочем, вы и так догадались, верно?

Данные индекса отсутствовали в версии для +3 в Issue 28, но они были включены в данные Issue 29, так что загрузите их в OUTDEX, и всё будет в порядке.

Нам поступали вопросы, почему на +3 портятся листинги. Виной тому особенность 128K BASIC: при нажатии BREAK он переключается на другую страницу памяти и больше не видит загруженный набор символов (шрифтов). Если сбросить компьютер и сделать MERGE программы, листинг будет виден нормально.

Возможно, вы видели картриджи для microdrive в рекламе по `4.50–`4.75, но уверяем вас: мы будем держать цену на OUTLET на microdrive, пока не кончатся запасы, хотя мы берём всего около ПОЛОВИНЫ от этой суммы за картридж ВМЕСТЕ С OUTLET! (Увы, нет — купить 500 штук и перепродать с выгодой не получится!)

И наконец, спасибо всем читателям, приславшим адрес поставщика печатающей головки для Brother M1009. В скором времени мы её закажем, и полосатой графике придёт конец...
